data.one_liner: Utilities for the Dart VM Runtime including ANSI colors, file copying, and exit code values.
data.what_it_does: Provides helper utilities for Dart VM applications such as ANSI color wrappers for terminal output, file path copying functions, a process manager for spawning subprocesses, and a subscriber-safe wrapper around standard input.
use_when: You are building a command-line interface (CLI) or Dart VM script that needs terminal colors.
You need to spawn and manage external processes with forwarded I/O streams.
You need to copy directory trees recursively or check if files are executable.
avoid_when: You are building a Flutter mobile or web application where CLI terminal utilities and process spawning are not applicable.
strengths: Simplifies working with command-line processes and standard input streams.
Provides built-in ANSI coloring helpers for terminal output.
Includes recursive file and directory copying utilities.
weaknesses: Limited to Dart VM environments and does not apply to standard Flutter UI development.
Small feature set focused strictly on specific VM utilities.
